blocks.x: From beachfront spots in the Caribbean to all-inclusive experiences that make trip planning easy, Barceló Hotels and Resorts’ worldwide properties are a hit among couples, families, and friend groups. With close to 200 properties in their arsenal and over two dozen locations to pick from, no matter what type of vacation you’re planning this year, there’s a little something for every type of traveler. Best of all? Barceló has amazing deals and promo codes to help you enjoy your time off for less, including savings in top destinations like Costa Rica, Spain, and Mexico. With their all-inclusive packages, you can bundle everything together into one price, making it easy to stick to your budget without additional charges.

Or for those who prefer to make their own way, you can stick to an à la carte model and piece together your perfect itinerary yourself. While not every property in Barceló Hotels and Resorts’ line is all-inclusive, those that aren’t still offer delicious food, remarkable amenities, and fabulous design. From metropolitan hot spots in cities like Barcelona and Istanbul, to beachy getaways in Aruba and Portugal, there are tons of gorgeous Barceló properties at wonderful price points to pick from. Below, check out some of the best ways to save big when planning your next beachfront, city-based, or island vacation.
Get an extra 10% off with today’s top Barceló discount code

Save more on limited-time hotel offers happening this month, with a variety of Barceló promo codes active today. Unlock an extra 10% off with Barceló discount code 10HD26 at checkout, to save on Maya Palace, Bavaro Palace, Maya Riviera, Maya Colonial, Royal Hideaway Playacar, and more popular resorts. When you use the code CITY10, you can score an extra, stackable 10% off city hotels in destinations like Mexico City, Guadalajara, San José, and more (locations that already offer up to 20% off their hotels). Those with My Barceló membership accounts will see savings of up to 20% off on stays of three or more days, or trips booked 15 or more days in advance.
Save 40% on bookings with Barceló coupons and fall hotel offers

To really score big, escape the cooler temperatures by enjoying a beachy vacation at discounts of up to 40% off on all-inclusive or adults-only resorts. Whether you’re headed to Riviera Maya, Punta Cana, or Cancún, these sunny island destinations with sparkling waters, soft sand, and iconic sunsets are the perfect backdrop for a warm-weather escape away from regular day-to-day life. A few top picks include up to 40% off Barceló Bavaro Palace in Punta Cana, up to 30% off Barceló Maya Palace in the Riviera Maya, 40% off Occidental Xcaret in Playa del Carmen, and up to 40% off Barceló Aruba.
Unlock a My Barceló coupon for up to an extra 10% off

Sign up for Barceló’s free membership program to reap even more benefits. Those who join will immediately see savings of 5% on stays, alongside benefits like online check-in, exclusive My Barceló rates, complimentary special requests (subject to availability), and more. After your third reservation, discounts increase to 10%, and by the fifth reservation, you’ll gain even more benefits, like an exclusive telephone service which is being piloted in Spain. With these stackable savings, you can make your budget stretch further on already discounted properties.
Save even more with Barceló military and senior discounts

Seniors and military personnel can nab an additional 5% off reservations on select offers when booking through Barceló’s website. Qualified travelers include those who are over 65 years old or are military staff members. To redeem, click the appropriate box in the “discounts” section at the top of the page next to the location, dates, and number of people you’ll be traveling with. Once selected, move through the booking process as usual. These savings are sometimes stackable with other promotions, letting travelers get the most bang for their buck.
How to fix a Barceló discount code that’s not working

If your Barceló coupon code isn't working, be sure to check for typos, extra spaces, or incorrect capitalization, as well as any terms and conditions. You can also try clearing your browser’s cache and cookies, or switching devices or browsers. When all else fails, Barceló's Help team is there to assist.
